Name: Buford
Dialog: It's like we're all little wishes!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I feel alive! So alive! Whee!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: These dandelion sky pods are fantastic, Baljeet! Come on up!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Just give me a moment to water the last bit of our growth formula.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Did I just miss them?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (getting a stopwatch out) They should come back down in approximately eleven minutes.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (showing a blueprint) Darn! I really need their help.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh-hoo-hoo! My blueprint senses are tingling! What is that?

Name: Irving
Dialog: It's an invention idea I have. Flying unicycles! And I would love it if they could be powered by raw vegetables.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Huh, if you convert the basal molecules into an adenosine triphosphate engine, it might be theoretically possible.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Wow! You came up with that on your own?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Oh, yes, I can help you, Irving. I might just be the unsung intellectual giant of the group.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Are you tellin' Irving about how you're the unsung intellectual giant of the group?!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmmph! Well, I am.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Well, I'd love to have your help making this into an actual prototype! Maybe I could impress Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I admire your assertiveness, Irving, or should I say... (takes rolled up blueprint and "dubs" him with it like a knight) my new protégé?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Aye aye, Professor Baljeet! I know what we're going to—

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Say less.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Sorry, Agent P. I was cleaning your lair and forgot to move your chair back.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters angrily)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You know how Agent P feels about his chair— (He grunts as he falls over backwards.) Carl, where's my chair?

Name: Carl
Dialog: I had to clean your area too, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Curse your furniture-based shenanigans, Carl! (to Agent P, from the floor) Doof has done something to alter local gravity, so you should go check it out.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Buh-bye!

Name: Carl
Dialog: (gulps)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, you and I need to have a talk.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Every day, I stress out trying to bust those guys. But every day, I fail. (pulls her hair, then face plants onto the bed) It's like the universe is punishing me for bringing attention to it. (gasps) But what if I play it cool? Maybe then the Mysterious Force won't yank the rug out from under me. I'munna play hard to get. First, the perfect blasé fit. (She goes into her closet and changes into a more casual look with her hair in a bun.) Step one to a more blasé bust. If I care. I mean, I don't. (Puts on sunglasses and walks out the door, but then goes back in.) Blasé. (Goes back out.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (dressed as a sun) Ah, Perry the Platypus! Step into my orbit and be my satellite, permanently! Ha ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold, my Kind-of-a-Big-Deal-inator! You see, my ex-wife always says, "Heinz, the world doesn't revolve around you," which I-I got to thinking, what if it did? So I created this gravity vest. These planets just coalesced from, I don't know, pencil shavings and dust and skin flakes, whatever was lying around, which, at first, was sort of cool, but, now it's becoming a bit of a problem, Perry the Platypus. Look, I quickly realized that being the center of the universe isn't really all it's cracked up to be.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (offscreen) Dad, one of your planets just stole my jacket!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's okay, honey, it's on an orbit! It'll come back around! It's not all about you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Being cas-u-al, so cas-u-al. No vested interests whatsoever. Time to catch up on my correspondence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And thank you to you, Candace, for being so good at being so laid-back, and not caring about all the whatever the boys are doing right now. Whatever it is they're doing. Flying through the air.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Apropos of nothing, I wonder what Mom is doing. I could just call her, y'know, slowly and casually.

Name: Linda
Dialog: She always calls before the best part of the song. (answers) Yes, dear. What can I do for you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hi, Mom, how are you? Oh, that's neat. I was wondering if you'd care to come home at your leisure, if that's convenient for you. Or not. Y'know, totes chill.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh, are you feeling okay, dear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Definitely! Definitely. Just, you know, taking it easy, and not being interested in anything the boys may or may not, mayhaps be participating in or thereabouts, casually.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Your even tone and relaxed phone manner, while unsettling, are a real welcome change of pace, dear.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (through clenched teeth) I'm indifferent to that.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Honestly, I'm kind of done here. I'm just sitting in my car at the taco shop because I like the smell. (inhales, sighs) See ya next time, Luis! (drives away)

Name: Luis
Dialog: Next time maybe you could BUY SOMETHING!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, good, she's coming home. That's fine. I'm good and fine. (burbles) Reading, reading. (Babbles, which changes into...) Hehehehehehehehehehehe...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Looks... Looks like their orbits are tightening faster than I thought. Maybe... maybe we should wrap this up. I'm just feeling a little claustrophobic is what I'm saying. It's... It's... It's... It's okay. Okay. Just... Just a little too close for comfort. Hoo, boy. Is it getting hot in here or is it just thermonuclear puffy vest strapped to my person? Uh, maybe, Perry the Platypus, could you give me a little, eensy-weensy, itty-bitty cup of water? I'm just so hot. (He flaps his arms and is suddenly airborne.) Okay, this is getting weird. I guess I didn't understand the... the literal gravity of the situation. I think I'm just gonna hit the self-destruct button on— Oh, no! Oh, no, my arm! Bad planet!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (muffled) Help me, Perry the Platypus! Help!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We have made real progress today, my young padawan.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (salutes) Thank you, Mr. Baljeet, sir!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Finally, we have been able to harness the energy in raw vegetables to power the unicycle. But how will we make it fly?

Name: Irving
Dialog: Hold on, that reminds me of something that was made by Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And me! (chuckles)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And just what are those?

Name: Irving
Dialog: I make a complete log of every one of Phineas and Ferb... and your... inventions.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is... creepy.

Name: Irving
Dialog: And thorough! (shows a blueprint)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The blender-copter! Of course! Those cloud milkshakes brought all the boys to the yard, and Isa, too.

Name: Irving
Dialog: If we used the rotating blades as a propulsion unit... (gasps) ...it might actually work!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (blinks) Huh. I had not noticed that. I acknowledge your accomplishment with limited praise as an emotionally-restrained mentor. Let us do this!!!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And the cherry on top!

Name: Irving
Dialog: (straps goggles on) Ooh, here goes something!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Candace, check it out!

Name: Buford
Dialog: What we're doin' is fun!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wheeee!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-huh. I'm totally neutral about what you're doing there. (gasps)

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're so close, Candace! Don't cave now! The Mysterious Force is watching! So as long as you stay cool and casual. (to Mom) Come. Hee hee. Casually this way. MOM! (giggles) Here we go. Just walk with me.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (concerned) Sure, hon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, glad you're here to see the unique tint of our house paint.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Taste that with your eyes. Did you notice how sour a color it is?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Never really noticed that, no. But, honey, don't you want me to look in the backyard to see—

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no! Not when the height of the front lawn is so sublime.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Wow, sounds like the kids are having fun!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs) I'm so neutral, so, whatever. But these bumps in the asphalt so wonderfully avant-garde.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Anyway, maybe, let's, like, go inside. Or we could just go in through the backyard for no reason. None at all, even.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (muffled) Perry the Platypus, would you mind hitting the self-destruct button? I think my shoulders have to make a big bang.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thank you, Perry the Platypus! You're the center of my universe!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Everyone inside for pie!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Come on! We can just catch them!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pretending to yawn)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (laughs crazily) But but but but...

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Blasé is a total bust. Bust, bust, bust! (babbles)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Let it all out, honey. I'm relieved the other shoe has finally dropped. And you're right. It is a little sour. (takes her into the house) We should repaint the house.

Name: Irving
Dialog: (gasps) The invention got taken away. (happily) My invention got taken away, just like Phineas and Ferb, and Baljeet's, always does!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: and **Buford**: "And Baljeet's"?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I helped!

Name: Irving
Dialog: How amazing is that?! I'm gonna go get started on my next invention so that invention can get taken away, too! Just like my heroes' inventions do! Woo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Yahoo! (He crashes through the fence, leaving an Irving-shaped hole behind.) Yow! (chuckles)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What was that all about?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, the gate's right there.
